scripts.//build: `cd`, not `--workspace`: `bun run` rewrites a nested `npm run` to `bun run`, which drops the flag, re-enters this script and recurses until something dies.
scripts.build: bun scripts/sync-readme.ts && cd packages/kit && bun run build
scripts.//contract: Generates, builds, serves, probes and ejects the example app against the pinned template. The one check that runs the generator, so the only one that notices the template's layout moving or the framework changing under a bump.
scripts.//typecheck:scripts: `scripts/` is repo tooling that bun runs straight from TypeScript, so nothing emits it and nothing else would check it.
